name: Do pentaquark particles exist?
posed_evidence: possibility of five-quark particles was identified as early as 1964
statement: Do particles made of four quarks and one antiquark exist, as the quark model allowed from 1964, and can a collider experiment find them in baryon decays?
status_source: Wikipedia, Pentaquark: "the LHCb collaboration at CERN reported results consistent with pentaquark states"

name: Can a quantum system have a ground state in perpetual motion?
posed_evidence: first proposed theoretically by Alfred Shapere and Frank Wilczek in 2012
statement: Can a quantum system have a ground state in repeating motion, as Shapere and Wilczek proposed in 2012, given that only periodically driven discrete time crystals have been observed?
status_source: Wikipedia, Time crystal: "Discrete time crystals have in fact been observed in physics laboratories"

name: What is the charge radius of the proton?
posed_evidence: This value was challenged by a 2010 experiment using a third method
statement: Why did muonic hydrogen spectroscopy in 2010 give a proton charge radius about four percent smaller than electron scattering and hydrogen spectroscopy, and which value is right?
status_source: Wikipedia, Proton radius puzzle: "New experimental results reported in the autumn of 2019 agree with"
